---
title: "Analyzing School District Reading Scores"
author: "Jack Greer"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = "data/seda_2025.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)
dbplyr_dist <- tbl(con, "district_scores")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| cache.extra: !expr file.mtime("data/seda_2025.duckdb")
district_2015 <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year == 2015, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, score_2015 = rla_score)

district_2023 <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year == 2023, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, score_2023 = rla_score)

score_change <- inner_join(
  district_2015,
  district_2023,
  by = c("district_id", "district_name", "state")
) |>
  mutate(rla_change = score_2023 - score_2015) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, rla_change) |>
  collect()

dbplyr_state <- tbl(con, "state_scores")

state_2015 <- dbplyr_state |>
  filter(year == 2015, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, score_2015 = rla_score)

state_2023 <- dbplyr_state |>
  filter(year == 2023, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, score_2023 = rla_score)

state_change <- inner_join(
  state_2015,
  state_2023,
  by = c("stateabb", "state_name")
) |>
  mutate(score_change = score_2023 - score_2015) |>
  collect()

print(state_change)
```

```{r}
score_change |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rla_change, fill = rla_change > 0)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(`FALSE` = "firebrick", `TRUE` = "steelblue"),
    labels = c(`FALSE` = "Negative or no change", `TRUE` = "Positive change"),
    name = "Reading score change"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of District Reading Score Changes",
    subtitle = paste("Districts with scores in both years:", nrow(score_change)),
    caption = "Change is the 2023 reading score minus the 2015 score.",
    x = "Change in reading score (2015 to 2023)",
    y = "Number of districts"
  )
```

```{r}
state_change |>
  ggplot(aes(
    y = reorder(state_name, score_2023),
    x = score_2015,
    xend = score_2023,
    yend = reorder(state_name, score_2023),
    color = score_change > 0
  )) +
  geom_segment(
    arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(0.15, "inches")),
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = score_2015), color = "gray50", size = 1.8) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(`FALSE` = "firebrick", `TRUE` = "steelblue"),
    labels = c(`FALSE` = "Negative or no change", `TRUE` = "Positive change"),
    name = "Reading score change"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "State Reading Score Changes, 2015 to 2023",
    subtitle = "States are ordered by their 2023 reading score; gray dots mark 2015 scores.",
    caption = "Arrows point from 2015 to 2023. Source: SEDA 2025.",
    x = "Reading score",
    y = NULL
  )
```
